meta.title: Client SIA 380/2 compliance criteria -- machine-readable manifest
meta.purpose: Single structured checklist to evaluate a client VE model + .aps against SIA 380/2:2022. runtime_status is filled per model by swiss_sia/compliance_criteria_evaluator.py. Missing evidence never becomes PASS.
meta.generated_from: swiss_sia/config.py: SIA_COMPLIANCE_REQUIREMENT_MATRIX + SIA_DATA_COVERAGE_MATRIX (regulatory values sourced there, not here)

compliant_requires_all: no determined blocking (CRITICAL/HIGH) finding in the six domains
the reviewed global comparison does not contradict acceptance (project <= reference)
no domain left NOT_DETERMINED (no MISSING / NOT_CHECKABLE / placeholder)
the decisive global comparison is present and REVIEWED_RESULT_AVAILABLE
verdict_logic.note: Component criteria are diagnostics; they do not decide compliance. SIA 380/2 decides on the global project/reference comparison (the decisive_gate below).

runtime_status_legend.TO_BE_EVALUATED: Static template value; not yet run against a model.
runtime_status_legend.OK: Evidence present from the model/.aps; no blocking finding.
runtime_status_legend.PARTIAL: Some evidence present; at least one input still missing.
runtime_status_legend.NOT_OK: A determined blocking finding (value out of range / contradiction).
runtime_status_legend.NOT_CHECKABLE: Required model/.aps evidence missing or placeholder; never a pass.
runtime_status_legend.NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_VE: VE structurally cannot produce this; not auto-decidable.

data_source_legend.ve_static_model: VE static model via the model/CDB API (geometry, constructions, systems).
data_source_legend.aps_simulation_results: ApacheSim .aps/Vista results via ResultsReader (dynamic needs, temperatures, energy). The .aps is the required source for every dynamic criterion; it is read at runtime inside VE (iesve.ResultsReader, binary format), by swiss_sia/simulation_results.py, and its quantities fill each aps criterion's runtime_status. See each aps criterion's aps_quantities.
data_source_legend.reviewer_or_external_evidence: Reviewer CSV or official/manufacturer files under sia4010_evidence/.

ve_capability_legend.VE_AVAILABLE: VE exposes this directly; the Run-button script extracts it automatically.
ve_capability_legend.VE_PARTIAL: VE can expose it, but the value may be missing/ambiguous per model; it then falls to NOT_CHECKABLE (never a silent pass) and may need a reviewer confirmation.
ve_capability_legend.EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE: VE does not produce this; it is supplied as reviewer/official evidence files under sia4010_evidence/.
ve_capability_legend.NOT_AVAILABLE: No path in VE (or in the current toolchain) produces this today; it cannot be auto-decided and must never be inferred.

decisive_gate.criterion: Project global energy-expenditure index <= reference-project index
decisive_gate.ve_capability_note: Not computed automatically (the reference project is not simulated client-side). Provide the accepted reviewer record: see docs/project/GUIDE_COMPARAISON_GLOBALE_SIA3802.md and its CSV template.

criteria.criterion: Project location, altitude, weather file and SIA 2028 DRY / CH2018 climate basis
criteria.expected_value: Documented Swiss climate basis; SIA 4010 summer/heating/cooling design periods where applicable
criteria.article_source: SIA 380/2:2022 FR, chapitres 4-7 et annexe A; SIA 4010:2023 FR, page PDF 8, clauses 2.3-2.6
criteria.data_needed: VE project settings, weather file name, location, altitude and climate scenario
criteria.expected_source: VE project settings plus reviewer-approved project metadata CSV
criteria.preferred_format: SIA3802_project_metadata_<project>.csv plus VE project weather settings
criteria.next_action: Fill the generated project metadata CSV and ensure its reviewed weather filename matches the active VE project weather.

criteria.criterion: Thermal rooms/zones, floor area and volume
criteria.expected_value: Complete heated/cooled room set with auditable area and volume
criteria.article_source: SIA 380/2:2022 FR, chapitres 4-7 et annexe A
criteria.data_needed: Room id, name, floor area, volume and zone membership
criteria.expected_source: IESVE model API
criteria.preferred_format: Extracted directly by the Run-button script
criteria.next_action: Resolve any missing/duplicated VE rooms before relying on scores.

criteria.criterion: SIA 2024 use category mapping for schedules, gains and glazing-related assumptions
criteria.expected_value: One justified SIA 2024 use category per thermal zone
criteria.article_source: SIA 380/2:2022 FR, chapitres 4-7 et annexe A
criteria.data_needed: Zone use, schedules, occupancy, equipment and lighting assumptions
criteria.expected_source: VE room templates plus reviewer mapping
criteria.preferred_format: Excel/CSV mapping table: VE room -> SIA 2024 category
criteria.next_action: Provide or confirm the room-to-SIA-2024 mapping.

criteria.criterion: External opaque surfaces with areas and types
criteria.expected_value: External walls, roofs and floors classified with gross/net areas
criteria.data_needed: Surface type, external/internal status, area, construction id
criteria.expected_source: IESVE model API
criteria.preferred_format: Extracted directly by the Run-button script
criteria.next_action: Improve classification where VE surface type/adjacency is ambiguous.

criteria.criterion: Opaque construction U-values
criteria.expected_value: Table 3 reference-project inputs: wall 0.20, roof 0.20, ground floor 0.30 W/(m2K)
criteria.data_needed: U-value per external opaque construction
criteria.expected_source: IESVE CDB/construction data
criteria.preferred_format: Extracted CDB properties or construction schedule export
criteria.next_action: Confirm construction U-values and floor/roof classification.

criteria.criterion: Linear and point thermal-bridge contribution (psi/chi or approved aggregate method)
criteria.expected_value: Explicit project-specific thermal-bridge calculation; use zero only when the applicable official reference/test definition explicitly prescribes zero
criteria.data_needed: Junction lengths and psi-values, point chi-values, or a reviewed equivalent calculation
criteria.expected_source: Thermal-bridge schedule/calculation and applicable SIA reference/test definition
criteria.ve_capability_note: VE exposes no psi/chi thermal-bridge quantity to read; an empty field must NOT be read as zero, and the reference-model 0.0 is a placeholder, not evidence. Requires a reviewed external thermal-bridge calculation.
criteria.preferred_format: Reviewed CSV/XLSX/PDF schedule identifying every junction and source
criteria.next_action: Attach a reviewed thermal-bridge calculation. Do not infer zero from an empty VE field or from the reference-model placeholder.

criteria.criterion: Window Uw
criteria.expected_value: Table 2 reference-project Uw inputs: limit case 1.10 and target case 0.88 W/(m2K)
criteria.data_needed: External window areas, construction ids and Uw values
criteria.expected_source: IESVE opening/construction data
criteria.preferred_format: Extracted directly by the Run-button script
criteria.next_action: Confirm the extracted value is total window Uw, not glass-only U.

criteria.criterion: Glazing normal solar factor
criteria.expected_value: Table 2 reference-project g_perp input 0.50 where applicable
criteria.data_needed: External glazing g-value or SHGC mapping
criteria.expected_source: IESVE CDB get_g_values().bs_en_410 or reviewer/manufacturer mapping note
criteria.preferred_format: Extracted value plus note confirming EN 410 g_perp/SHGC interpretation
criteria.next_action: Use bs_en_410 as the automatic SIA g_perp candidate; keep raw CDB g_value as audit evidence until reviewed.

criteria.criterion: Glazing visible light transmittance
criteria.expected_value: Table 2 reference-project tau_v input 0.70 where applicable
criteria.data_needed: Visible transmittance per glazing construction
criteria.expected_source: IESVE CDB glazing data or manufacturer evidence
criteria.preferred_format: CDB export or manufacturer glazing schedule
criteria.next_action: Extract visible transmittance or request glazing evidence.

criteria.criterion: Window frame fraction
criteria.expected_value: Frame fraction reference value 0.25
criteria.data_needed: Frame/glass split or equivalent window construction definition
criteria.expected_source: IESVE opening construction data or external schedule
criteria.preferred_format: Window schedule with frame fraction
criteria.next_action: Document frame fraction or equivalent VE modelling assumption.

criteria.criterion: Solar protection category, optical properties and control strategy
criteria.expected_value: SIA 380/2 table 10 categories and active-control evidence
criteria.article_source: SIA 380/2:2022 FR, tableau 10, page PDF 46; SIA 4010:2023 FR, tableau 65, page PDF 52
criteria.data_needed: Blind type, reflectance/transmittance, active g_total and control thresholds
criteria.expected_source: VE shading data plus reviewer evidence
criteria.preferred_format: Shading schedule/export and control strategy note
criteria.next_action: Map VE shading devices and controls to SIA categories.

criteria.criterion: Reference infiltration / airtightness input
criteria.expected_value: 0.15 m3/(h.m2) reference value where applicable
criteria.data_needed: Infiltration value and unit conversion basis per room or facade
criteria.expected_source: IESVE air-exchange data plus unit mapping
criteria.preferred_format: Extracted air-exchange data or infiltration schedule
criteria.next_action: Confirm unit conversion to m3/(h.m2) where VE exposes different units.

criteria.criterion: Occupancy, equipment and lighting gains
criteria.expected_value: Use-specific gains consistent with SIA 2024/project assumptions
criteria.article_source: SIA 380/2:2022 FR, chapitres 4-7 et annexe A
criteria.data_needed: People, equipment, lighting gains and schedules
criteria.expected_source: VE room templates/internal gains
criteria.preferred_format: VE template export or room-use schedule
criteria.next_action: Provide missing schedules and verify use-category assumptions.

criteria.criterion: Occupancy, HVAC, lighting, shading and equipment schedules
criteria.expected_value: Auditable schedules used by annual and design-period simulations
criteria.article_source: SIA 380/2:2022 FR, chapitres 4-7 et annexe A
criteria.data_needed: Hourly/weekly schedules and exceptions
criteria.expected_source: VE profiles/templates or exported schedule workbook
criteria.preferred_format: CSV/XLSX schedule export
criteria.next_action: Review extracted daily-equivalent profile hours and attach full weekly/exception schedules where required.

criteria.criterion: Design ventilation rate by room/area
criteria.expected_value: Rate needed to select table 4 control band
criteria.data_needed: Outdoor air / supply airflow per room and floor area
criteria.expected_source: IESVE air-exchange data
criteria.preferred_format: Extracted air-exchange data
criteria.next_action: Normalize airflow to m3/(h.m2) and connect to control bands.

criteria.criterion: Ventilation control class / airflow modulation
criteria.expected_value: Table 4 control strategy by system type and airflow band
criteria.data_needed: Monozone/multizone flag, fan control, demand-control sensors and minimum flow
criteria.expected_source: VE system/AHU data plus reviewer confirmation
criteria.preferred_format: AHU/system schedule and controls note
criteria.next_action: Review the extracted monozone/multizone and control mapping; attach evidence where VE does not expose a decisive identifier.

criteria.criterion: AHU leakage, heat recovery, pressure drops and heat transfer
criteria.expected_value: Duct class C, AHU L2/L1 and heat-recovery values per SIA tables where applicable
criteria.article_source: SIA 380/2:2022 FR, tableau 4, page PDF 37; SIA 4010:2023 FR, pages PDF 11-17 and 24-28
criteria.data_needed: Duct/AHU leakage class, heat recovery type/efficiency, pressure drops, fan data
criteria.expected_source: VE AHU/system data and external design evidence
criteria.preferred_format: AHU schedule/export and fan/heat-recovery data sheet
criteria.next_action: Use extracted recovery/control identifiers and attach leakage, pressure-drop, efficiency and humidification evidence for tests 5 and 6.

criteria.criterion: Cooling generator type, power band, EER/SEER and part-load data
criteria.expected_value: SIA 380/2 tables 5-7 values by generator type/power band
criteria.data_needed: Generator type, rated power, EER/SEER, part-load curve and heat rejection type
criteria.expected_source: VE Apache systems, plant data and manufacturer evidence
criteria.ve_capability_note: Generator type/EER extractable, but the seasonal SEER equivalence rests on SN EN 14825, which is absent from refs/: the SEER verdict stays indicative [TO VERIFY], not a proven pass.
criteria.preferred_format: Cooling plant schedule/export
criteria.next_action: Review extracted generator class, capacity, EER and SEER; attach Table 7 EER+ and part-load evidence where applicable.

criteria.criterion: Heat-pump type, power band and SCOP / SIA 384/3 evidence
criteria.expected_value: SIA 380/2 tables 8-9 values where heat pumps are applicable
criteria.data_needed: Generator type, rated power, SCOP, hourly method evidence for heat pumps
criteria.expected_source: VE plant data and manufacturer/evaluation evidence
criteria.ve_capability_note: Heat-pump type/SCOP extractable, but the seasonal SCoP equivalence rests on SN EN 14825 (absent from refs/): the SCoP verdict stays indicative [TO VERIFY], not a proven pass.
criteria.preferred_format: Heating plant schedule/export
criteria.next_action: Review extracted heat-pump class, capacity and SCOP; attach evidence when the source/type is not exposed by VE.

criteria.criterion: Lighting power and SIA 387/4 daylight/presence control
criteria.expected_value: Lighting control evidence compatible with SIA 387/4 references
criteria.data_needed: Lighting power density, schedules, daylight control and presence control
criteria.expected_source: VE gains/templates plus reviewer evidence
criteria.ve_capability_note: Lighting power/schedules extractable, but SIA 387/4 (control reference) is absent from refs/: the control verdict cannot be closed without it.
criteria.preferred_format: Lighting schedule/export and control strategy note
criteria.next_action: Map VE lighting controls to SIA 387/4 categories.

criteria.criterion: APS/Vista hourly or sub-hourly results available for the active model
criteria.expected_value: Readable APS file with timestep metadata and room/system variables
criteria.article_source: SIA 380/2:2022 FR, chapitres 4-7 et annexe A
criteria.data_needed: APS file, variable list, room results and timestep
criteria.expected_source: IESVE ResultsReader inside VE
aps_quantities: readable .aps in the project Vista folder
room and system variable list via get_variables()
criteria.preferred_format: APS/Vista results in the project Vista folder
criteria.next_action: Confirm the selected APS weather provenance and the actual room/system variables exposed by ResultsReader.

criteria.criterion: Hourly temperature / overheating indicators
criteria.expected_value: Occupied hours outside the SIA 180 upper/lower curves over a complete annual series
criteria.article_source: SIA 380/2:2022 FR, chapitres 4-7 et annexe A
criteria.data_needed: Room temperature, SIA 180 upper/lower limit curves, occupancy and timestep
criteria.expected_source: APS/Vista room results
aps_quantities: hourly room temperature series (dry resultant temperature)
criteria.preferred_format: APS/Vista results or exported CSV/XLSX
criteria.destination: VE project Vista folder or sia4010_evidence/
criteria.next_action: Confirm full-year temperature, occupancy and SIA 180 limit-curve variables; fixed 26/27 C indicators remain diagnostic only.

criteria.criterion: Annual heating/cooling demand and peak loads
criteria.expected_value: kWh and kWh/m2 by room/building, plus peak W where available
criteria.article_source: SIA 4010:2023 FR, tableau 62 page PDF 46; annexe A page PDF 51
criteria.data_needed: Heating load, cooling load, room area and timestep
criteria.expected_source: APS/Vista room results
criteria.preferred_format: APS/Vista results or exported CSV/XLSX
criteria.destination: VE project Vista folder or sia4010_evidence/
criteria.next_action: Review annual room-load integration and add the separate design-day peak workflow required by the standard.

criteria.criterion: Design power from the prescribed heating and cooling design-day sequences
criteria.expected_value: Four heating reference days or three cooling reference days after fourteen preconditioning days
criteria.data_needed: Dedicated design-day APS results, 15-minute load series and traceable weather/setup metadata
criteria.expected_source: IESVE ResultsReader using dedicated design-day simulations
aps_quantities: dedicated design-day .aps result files (NOT annual peaks)
15-minute load series over the prescribed heating/cooling design days
traceable weather/setup metadata for the design-day run
criteria.ve_capability_note: The prescribed heating/cooling design-day workflow is NOT_IMPLEMENTED; annual room peaks must never be substituted for it.
criteria.preferred_format: Dedicated APS/Vista design-day result files
criteria.destination: VE project Vista folder or sia4010_evidence/
criteria.next_action: Map dedicated design-day result files; never substitute annual room peaks for the prescribed method.

criteria.criterion: Official SIA test specifications
criteria.expected_value: Official test specification files for the selected class
criteria.data_needed: SIA 4010 official test files/specifications
criteria.expected_source: Official SIA package or responsible validation authority
criteria.preferred_format: PDF/DOCX/XLSX with filename prefix SIA4010_official_test_specs_
criteria.next_action: Place official test specifications in the evidence folder.

criteria.criterion: Official SIA evaluation workbooks
criteria.expected_value: Official evaluation workbook(s) for the selected validation class
criteria.data_needed: SIA official Excel evaluation files
criteria.expected_source: Official SIA package or responsible validation authority
criteria.preferred_format: XLSX with filename prefix SIA4010_official_evaluation_workbook_
criteria.next_action: Place official evaluation workbooks in the evidence folder.

criteria.criterion: Candidate IESVE results transferred into official files
criteria.expected_value: Candidate software outputs for every required official test
criteria.data_needed: APS/Vista outputs and filled evaluation workbooks
criteria.expected_source: IESVE results plus official SIA workbook
criteria.preferred_format: XLSX/CSV/PDF with filename prefix SIA4010_candidate_results_
criteria.next_action: Attach candidate results for every required SIA test.

criteria.criterion: Reference comparison plots/tables
criteria.expected_value: Official workbook comparisons against reference outputs
criteria.data_needed: Reference output comparisons, plots and deviations
criteria.expected_source: Official SIA evaluation workbook
criteria.preferred_format: PDF/XLSX with filename prefix SIA4010_reference_comparison_
criteria.next_action: Attach comparison evidence generated by the official workbook.

criteria.criterion: Validation class selected and confirmed
criteria.expected_value: Selected class and required test set confirmed
criteria.data_needed: Class confirmation and responsible reviewer/authority note
criteria.expected_source: SIA/sub-commission/client compliance decision
criteria.preferred_format: PDF/DOCX/TXT with filename containing class_4B, class_4A, etc.
criteria.next_action: Confirm which class is claimed before any final validation wording.
